definitions.explanation: Any liquid that can be drunk.

examples.english: What would you like to drink?

⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{飲|の}み{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おいしい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧。

notes:
{飲|の}み{物|もの} is the standard general word for any drink or beverage. It covers everything from water and tea to alcohol.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{飲|の}み{物|もの}: cold drink
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧{飲|の}み{物|もの}: warm/hot drink
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: What would you like to drink?
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order a drink

FORMS:
Follows the verb-stem + ⟦{物|もの}→もの：02259_mono⟧ pattern, meaning "something to [verb]":
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}: something to drink
- ⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧: something to eat
- ⟦{読|よ}み{物|もの}→読み物：14216_yomimono⟧: reading material
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: shopping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ドリンク→ドリンク：23507_dorinku⟧: drink (loanword, often used in menus and product names)
- ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧: beverage (more formal/written, as in ⟦{飲料水|いんりょうすい}→飲料水：15275_inryousui⟧ — drinking water)
